source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Eq. (3) and shared-order assumptions; Section 4.6, Assumption 2, Assumption 3, and Theorem 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes a shared causal ordering, states Assumption 2 as edgewise within-view correlation plus cross-view correlation diversity, and identifies the partial order and view-specific coefficients under that assumption; Assumption 3 adds unique-order identification.
The paper's Section 3.1 presents the exogenous-variable criterion, residual closure after removing a true exogenous variable, and preservation of the residual causal order.
The paper recursively enumerates MPDAG subclasses having distinct identified total-effect functionals, addressing duplicate graphical-effect outputs.
The paper gives exact enumeration of Markov-equivalent DAGs with linear delay through an MCS-based graphical representation.

source_verification_receipts.version: ESA 2021 public version of the equivalence-enumeration result
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work gives polynomial-delay enumeration for equivalence classes represented by colored subtrees of acyclic decomposable AND--OR graphs; it does not establish such a local congruence for LiMVAM numerical tuples.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a short corollary that explicitly separates what follows from applying Heurtebise et al. to the calibrated pair from the new step: fixed-pair genericity plus marginal-Cholesky recovery of every unpaired view.

Prove or sharply delimit whether the fixed-pair generic result survives when component alignment is weakened to the published LiMVAM disturbance class; this would distinguish a field result from a merely restrictive-subclass corollary.

Give an exact finite-sample implementation theorem for testing the algebraic exceptional locus or for selecting a pair before costly alignment, including the sample-size dependence of the residual-margin test.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the generic fixed-pair theorem as the field-tier kernel; preserve the strict component-aligned scope and make the pair-to-all-views recovery decomposition explicit in the derivation.
